ops.title: CI scripts job: render and shellcheck the closure-enabled plugins.sh and provision.sh
ops.description: Deferred by root's scope freeze (2026-10-02) until the first complete fresh timing on the closure head. ci.yml's scripts job renders only payload-free scripts, so shellcheck never sees the apt.payload branches; the b85a557 trim bug showed template branches can break silently. Source: astra refuter closure-b85a557-refuter.json claim 9.

ops.text: The CI scripts job renders plugins.sh and provision.sh for a fixture inventory with apt.payload and a selected payload and shellchecks them
A deliberately broken closure-only template branch fails the scripts job
